gasstations.description: One row per individual gas station.

columns.gasstationid: Unique identifier for the gas station.
columns.chainid: Identifier of the owning fuel chain; values range roughly 63 to 290.
columns.country: Three‑letter country code (e.g., CZE, SVK) where the station is located.
columns.segment: Market segment label: Other, Premium, Noname, Value for money, Discount.

columns.description: Product name or label, e.g., 'Ostatni zbozi', 'Servisní poplatek', 'Katalyzátor'.

transactions_1k.description: One row per gas station transaction, capturing date, time, customer, card, product, amount, and price.

columns.time: Time of day or duration in MM:SS or HH:MM:SS format.
columns.customerid: Foreign key to the customer who made the purchase.
columns.cardid: Identifier of the payment card used.
columns.gasstationid: Foreign key to the gas station where the transaction occurred.
columns.productid: Foreign key to the product (fuel type) purchased.
columns.amount: Quantity of product purchased, likely in gallons or liters.
columns.price: Monetary amount of the transaction in local currency.

yearmonth.description: One row per customer per month with consumption aggregate.

columns.date: Year and month as text in YYYYMM format.
columns.consumption: Possibly total consumption; numeric value, units unspecified.
